status: PROPOSAL -- NOT FROZEN AND NOT A PREREGISTRATION. The formal phase opens only on plans/volume_preregistration.json, which this programme does not write: the precondition below fails under the fixed recovery recipe.

fixed.method: the forward baseline, resolved through shared.forward_baseline (stage1_init.d1_target_aware.scored_v1@v1)

treatments.dose_unit: unique effective scored positions (UESP) under positions.supervised_target_v1
treatments.resamples: independent sampling seeds per dose; doses nested within a resample
treatments.per_treatment: one D1 full search (beam width 6, delayed_prune warm-up 1, pareto@v2) with operator order and the profile per operator FREE, over two mixtures at the treatment's dose and resample: base (0.72 static primary / 0.28 supporting, the pilot's) and a reasoning-heavy variant -- the D1 search's own two-profile shape
treatments.hardware: NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB: the base pool's 8,192-token items put up to 22,141 scored rows into one micro-batch of 3; a 44 GiB card OOMs in DEPTH (pilot_20261018_122808)

endpoints.H1: between-resample agreement at each dose of the committed Top-1: its operator order and per-step profile, and per operator FFN/ATTENTION per-layer Jaccard, DEPTH removed-set Jaccard, WIDTH subspace overlap; each beside chance
endpoints.H2: correctness of each treatment's recovered Top-1 on the capability battery's final split (evaluation families; the five evaluation-only generators reported separately), per P10.2 axis and pooled over the four static primary axes; interactive reported, not pooled
endpoints.H3: the dose-response shape across 1x/2x/4x for H1 and H2

statistics.inference: rule-family cluster bootstrap (10,000 resamples, stratified by axis), tasks paired across treatments, recovery seeds and resamples averaged within treatment; 95% intervals on each dose contrast
statistics.h1_reading: the pilot's noise-calibrated rule (plans/pilot_analysis_plan.json), on full-search Top-1s

precondition.rule: before any formal spend, a control recovered under the fixed recipe must score above floor on dev_v1, with a seed-discordance-based minimal detectable effect at or below the pooled SESOI
precondition.why_not: both 0.86M controls score 0/720 and never disagree, so no minimal detectable effect exists: every recovered treatment would score zero by construction

F_full.what: the brief's study: 1x/2x/4x, three independent resamples each, one D1 full search per treatment, the fixed recovery on each Top-1 at two recovery seeds, capability battery final split

MVP_A_h1_only.what: H1 (and H3 at two doses) only: 1x/2x x three resamples, six full searches, no recovery. Answers whether full-search selection stabilizes with volume; says nothing about capability

MVP_B_h1_h2.what: the smallest study that can address H2: 1x/2x x three resamples with two recovery seeds per Top-1 -- under a recovery recipe that first passes the precondition below, which the fixed 0.86M rung fails

cost_levers.dominant_term: DEPTH: token-linear, and the pool's long teacher-native items make it the bulk of every search (see full_search_by_dose.per_impl)
cost_levers.per_expansion_overhead: measured ~1.25 min per expansion here against D2's 0.14; the reload validation runs on the host, where torch sizes its pools from the host's CPU count rather than the pod's cgroup grant (suspected, not measured). An execution knob worth ~115 min per full search
cost_levers.item_length_bound: a data-design choice, not an execution knob: D1's [256, 2,048] window keeps 66 of 572 verified teacher units and no analogy or interactive unit (audit section C)
cost_levers.faster_card: an H100-class card is unmeasured on this workload; its price is ~2.2x the A100's
